DA.data_type: Tweets collected based on hashtags and classified as denier or believer. The hashtags were derived from the literature or from previous climate deniers vs believers datasets. It was annotated using a label propagation framework (Tyagi et al. 2020a,b,), where the model uses seed hashtags to label other hashtags. The annotations were validated: human annotators review a sample of the data. The resulting tweets come both from previous datasets and from tweets the authors collected.
DA.modality: text | Event / interaction logs (timestamped user actions such as clicks, likes, shares)
DA.new: existing dataset extended with new data or annotations

DA.data_type: Twitter data was collected using the Twitter API with keywords “Climate Change”, “#ActOnClimate”, “#ClimateChange”. 100 weeks of data were collected between August 2017 and September 2019.
DA.modality: text | Event / interaction logs (timestamped user actions such as clicks, likes, shares)
DA.theme: climate change | Climate supporters vs deniers
DA.annot_model: prelabel (the model pre-labels with human review)
